roadmap.title: Raise the Goat Castle
roadmap.description: Watch the intro, synchronize the six Goat Towers and bank Illuminati Points from events until the castle reaches S tier, then beat the final boss behind the sealed door.

roadmap.title: Base-game events and odd jobs
roadmap.description: Complete the named world events and one-off secrets that unlock individual base-game achievements.

roadmap.title: Base-game collectibles and cleanup
roadmap.description: Finish the base-game ramps, movie tapes, trinkets, instincts and the castle redecoration, then clean up remaining odds and ends.

roadmap.title: Multiverse of Nonsense
roadmap.description: Play the DLC story across Koztroit, Durville and Mount Olympus, then finish its trinkets, broken relics and instincts.

roadmap.title: Baadlands: Furry Road
roadmap.description: Complete the post-apocalyptic DLC: its story, Pilgor Town upgrades, Hooferdome trials and collectibles.

roadmap.title: Complete the set
roadmap.description: G.O.A.T. unlocks automatically once every other achievement is earned.

achievements.description: Become an Egg
achievements.summary: Complete the @loc{Home Grown Chicken} event to become an egg.

guide.context: The event takes place at the chicken farm, where a bowl and a bell sit under an overhead line.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{chicken farm} and start the @loc{Home Grown Chicken} event.
Sit in the bowl and jump, then fire the @item{gum gun} at the bell above you while ragdolling.
Hit the bell to finish the event and turn into an egg.

achievements.description: Shrink the shrink house and lick it.
achievements.summary: Lick the shrink house after shrinking it from the couch inside.

steps.text: Enter the marked house and lie down on the couch.
Scream while lying on the couch so the house shrinks around you.
Lick the shrunken house to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Run on the beach in slow motion
achievements.summary: Run along the beach while @mechanic{slow motion} is active.

guide.context: Slow motion is a toggle, so it can be switched on before you reach the sand.

steps.text: Go to the beach and activate @mechanic{slow motion}.
steps.note: On a controller this is a d-pad direction; check the controls bindings if unsure.

steps.text: Run along the sand until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Raise the Goat Castle to F tier.
achievements.summary: Reach F tier in the @loc{Goat Castle}.

guide.context: The @loc{Goat Castle} is the game hub. Its rank rises as you collect @mechanic{Illuminati Points} from events, and each rank removes another lock from the sealed door in the main hall.

steps.text: Walk to the @loc{Goat Tower} near your spawn point and interact with its base to synchronize it.
steps.note: Synchronizing raises the tower and reveals the surrounding map.

steps.text: Enter the doorway that opens under the raised tower and stand on the glowing plate to be scanned.
Go into the main hall, jump over the rubble and collect the reward at the end.
steps.note: The F tier achievement unlocks after the following cutscene.

achievements.description: Raise the Goat Castle to E tier.
achievements.summary: Reach E tier in the @loc{Goat Castle}.

guide.context: Ranks above F are bought with @mechanic{Illuminati Points}. Return to the castle after each milestone and spend it on the next lock.

steps.text: Complete @loc{San Angora} events until you have banked enough @mechanic{Illuminati Points} for the next rank.
Return to the @loc{Goat Castle}, stand on the lit circle in front of the sealed door and remove the next lock to reach E tier.

achievements.description: Raise the Goat Castle to D tier.
achievements.summary: Reach D tier in the @loc{Goat Castle}.

guide.context: @mechanic{Illuminati Points} come from events and hidden secret events across the island, so keep clearing them as you explore.

steps.text: Keep finishing events around @loc{San Angora} to build up @mechanic{Illuminati Points}.
Return to the @loc{Goat Castle}, stand on the lit circle and remove the next door lock to reach D tier.

achievements.description: Raise the Goat Castle to C tier.
achievements.summary: Reach C tier in the @loc{Goat Castle}, which costs 55 @mechanic{Illuminati Points}.

guide.context: C tier is the first rank that changes the castle interior and unlocks the goat throne used by another achievement.

steps.text: Earn at least 55 @mechanic{Illuminati Points} by completing events around @loc{San Angora}.
Return to the @loc{Goat Castle} and step on the lit circle in front of the sealed door to remove the lock and reach C tier.

achievements.description: Raise the Goat Castle to B tier.
achievements.summary: Reach B tier in the @loc{Goat Castle}, which costs 90 @mechanic{Illuminati Points}.

guide.context: B tier opens castle customization and the VR headset, so the redecoration achievement becomes possible from here.

steps.text: Collect 90 @mechanic{Illuminati Points} by clearing events and secret events around the island.
steps.note: Ordinary events alone will not cover every tier; a few secret events are required.

steps.text: Return to the @loc{Goat Castle}, stand on the lit circle and remove the next lock to reach B tier.

achievements.description: Raise the Goat Castle to A tier.
achievements.summary: Reach A tier in the @loc{Goat Castle}, which costs 130 @mechanic{Illuminati Points}.

guide.context: A tier unlocks a castle teleport that jumps you to several points around the map, which shortens the remaining event grind.

steps.text: Earn 130 @mechanic{Illuminati Points} from events and secret events across @loc{San Angora}.
Return to the @loc{Goat Castle} and remove the next lock from the sealed door to reach A tier.

achievements.description: Raise the Goat Castle to S tier.
achievements.summary: Reach S tier in the @loc{Goat Castle}, which costs 175 @mechanic{Illuminati Points}.

guide.context: S tier is the final rank and opens the boss arena behind the sealed door. Reaching it means completing most of the story events.

steps.text: Collect 175 @mechanic{Illuminati Points} from events and secret events around @loc{San Angora}.
steps.note: Completing only the standard events leaves you short, so hunt down extra secret events.

steps.text: Return to the @loc{Goat Castle} and remove the last lock from the sealed door to reach S tier.

achievements.description: Use your Kärring to knock another Kärring down
achievements.summary: Knock over another @enemy{Kärring} using a @enemy{Kärring} turret of your own.

steps.text: Enter the retirement-home basement and finish the level there.
Open the chest at the end and pick up the @enemy{Kärring} turret.
Use the turret to destroy one other @enemy{Kärring} to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Make like Pinocchio and get eaten!
achievements.summary: Get swallowed by the whale during the @loc{Belly of the Beast} event.

steps.text: Start the @loc{Belly of the Beast} event and jump onto the buoy.
Let the whale swallow your goat to complete the event.

achievements.description: Lick a banana while transformed into Abominana.
achievements.summary: Lick a @item{banana} while transformed into @npc{Abominana}.

guide.context: The banana skin comes from the factory quest and is needed before you can transform.

steps.text: Go to the marked factory and complete the @loc{How It's Made} quest.
Enter the capsules that launch bananas to receive the @npc{Abominana} banana skin.
steps.note: You can also knock a banana off the conveyor on the right side of the factory.

steps.text: Transform into @npc{Abominana} and lick a @item{banana}.

achievements.displayName: Raider of the Lost Parking Garage
achievements.description: Find the perfectly round boulder
achievements.summary: Headbutt the perfectly round @item{boulder} inside the parking garage.

steps.text: Search the @loc{parking garage} for the perfectly round @item{boulder}.
Headbutt the @item{boulder} to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Run naked on the football field
achievements.summary: Run on the @loc{football field} wearing the @item{Birthday Suit} fur.

guide.context: The Birthday Suit fur is sold in the wardrobe only after the @loc{Goat Castle} reaches A tier, and it is also tied to the Save Steve quest.

steps.text: Raise the @loc{Goat Castle} to A tier so the @item{Birthday Suit} fur becomes available in the wardrobe.
Buy and equip the @item{Birthday Suit} fur.
steps.note: Only the fur is required; the other gear slots can stay as they are.

steps.text: Run across the @loc{football field} to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Get sprayed by the Fossil Fuel mascot.
achievements.summary: Get sprayed by the @npc{Fossil Fuel} mascot on the gas-station roof.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{gas station} and climb onto its roof.
Stand on the marked spot and wait for the @npc{Fossil Fuel} mascot to spray you.

achievements.description: Find That clown
achievements.summary: Find the @npc{clown} inside the marked building.

steps.text: Enter the marked building through its front entrance.
Approach the @npc{clown} inside to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Reach Goat Castle S tier, open the sealed door and defeat the final boss.
achievements.summary: Reach @loc{Goat Castle} S tier, open the sealed door and defeat the final boss inside.

guide.context: The final encounter is a scripted battle sequence that starts behind the fully unlocked castle door.

steps.text: Raise the @loc{Goat Castle} to S tier with 175 @mechanic{Illuminati Points}.
steps.note: See the S tier achievement for the point grind.

steps.text: Step on the lit circle to remove the last lock, then walk through the sealed door into the boss arena.
Complete the final boss battle to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Lick the croissant
achievements.summary: Lick the @item{golden donut} on the café display.

steps.text: Go to the marked café stand and hit the display case to knock the @item{golden donut} loose.
Lick the @item{golden donut}.

achievements.description: Stay for the full yoga session.
achievements.summary: Stay through the entire yoga session in the @loc{yoga studio}.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{yoga studio} and stay for the whole class.

achievements.description: Find the secret garage under the gas station.
achievements.summary: Reach the secret garage by driving a car into the garage beside the gas station and honking.

guide.context: The garage entrance sits right next to the gas station; the floor only descends with a vehicle parked on it.

steps.text: Bring any car to the @loc{garage} beside the gas station and drive it inside.
Honk the horn to make the floor descend into the secret basement.

achievements.description: Open the emote-locked door to the shady merchant.
achievements.summary: Find the @npc{shady merchant} behind the emote-locked back door.

guide.context: The door is unmarked and only reacts to an emote, not a normal interaction.

steps.text: Go to the marked back door and stand directly in front of it.
Perform an emote to make the door open, then approach the @npc{shady merchant} inside.

achievements.description: Unlock the Capra Erectus goat.
achievements.summary: Unlock the @npc{Capra Erectus} goat by freeing the figure sealed inside the marked rock.

steps.text: Travel to the marked rock and scream at it so the spirit lifts the rock away.
Enter the opening and approach the figure inside to unlock the @npc{Capra Erectus} skin.

achievements.description: Reach the dance floor of the hidden container rave.
achievements.summary: Reach the dance floor of the hidden container rave.

guide.context: A costume from the changing rooms is needed before the container lets you in.

steps.text: Enter the building with the changing rooms and use the left changing room to receive a costume.
Wearing the costume, enter the marked shipping container nearby.
Follow the container interior to the party club and step onto the dance floor.

achievements.description: Become Queen of all the goats
achievements.summary: Sit on the goat throne that appears in the @loc{Goat Castle} once it reaches C tier.

guide.context: At C tier the plastic chair at the top of the stairs to level 2 is replaced by a giant throne.

steps.text: Reach C tier in the @loc{Goat Castle}.
steps.note: C tier costs 55 Illuminati Points.

steps.text: Climb the stairs to level 2 and jump onto the large goat throne.

achievements.description: Reach the train station and finish the Dilbo's Journey event.
achievements.summary: Finish the @loc{Dilbo's Journey} event, which ends with a jump into the lava inside the train-station cave.

steps.text: Travel to the @loc{train station} and go inside to start the @loc{Dilbo's Journey} event.
Find the ring inside and follow it out to the cave.
Jump into the lava pool in the cave to finish the event.

achievements.description: Equip the [REDACTED] while playing as [REDACTED] with the [REDACTED] fur
achievements.summary: Wear the @item{Eggplant} head gear on @npc{Abominana} while its eggplant fur is also equipped.

guide.context: All three pieces must be active at the same time.

steps.text: Unlock and select the @npc{Abominana} goat.
Equip the eggplant fur in the fur category of the wardrobe.
Equip the @item{Eggplant} head gear on top of the fur.

achievements.description: Give Big Foot some shoes
achievements.summary: Hit @npc{Becky} with the @item{Big Feet} shots from the @item{Fashionista} gear.

steps.text: Find @npc{Becky} in the world and equip the @item{Fashionista} gear.
Shoot @npc{Becky} with the @item{Big Feet} projectiles until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Complete the 5G Upgrade event.
achievements.summary: Complete the @loc{5G Upgrade} event to start the alien invasion.

guide.context: The event uses several small towers that must be charged in quick succession.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{5G Upgrade} event and find the three mini towers that need charging.
Charge all three mini towers within the short time limit to activate one main tower.
steps.note: Repeat the charging step for the remaining main towers.

steps.text: After the last main tower activates, watch the cutscene to finish the event.

achievements.description: Watch the opening intro without skipping.
achievements.summary: Watch the opening intro sequence from the start without skipping it.

steps.text: Start a new game and let the opening @loc{San Angora} intro play all the way to the end.
steps.note: Do not skip the cutscene; the achievement only counts after the sequence finishes on its own.

achievements.description: Buy the Gators shoes.
achievements.summary: Buy the @item{Gators shoes} from the wardrobe shoe shop.

guide.context: The shoes cost in-game currency, so make sure you have enough before opening the wardrobe.

steps.text: Open the @mechanic{wardrobe} and go to the shoes category.
Buy the alligator-skin @item{Gators shoes}.

achievements.description: Find all movie tapes
achievements.summary: Collect all 6 @item{movie tapes} and play them in the cinema's VHS player.

guide.context: Each tape must be carried to the cinema one at a time and inserted into the large VHS player in the projector room.

collectibles.name: Cinema roof
collectibles.method: Climb onto the cinema roof and lick the tape.

collectibles.name: Entrance wall
collectibles.location: To the right of the cinema's main entrance.
collectibles.method: Follow the wall right of the entrance and lick the tape.

collectibles.name: Red stand
collectibles.method: Crawl under the stand and lick the tape.

collectibles.name: Roof billboard
collectibles.location: Beside the advertising billboard on the roof.
collectibles.method: Reach the roof, walk to the billboard and lick the tape.

collectibles.name: Yoga room
collectibles.location: In the room next to the yoga woman.
collectibles.method: Enter the room beside the yoga session and lick the tape.

collectibles.name: Shop front
collectibles.location: Beside the shop near the cinema.
collectibles.method: Lick the tape by the shop entrance.

achievements.description: Unlock all the achievements
achievements.summary: Unlock every other achievement in Goat Simulator 3.

steps.text: Earn every achievement in the base game and both expansions.
steps.note: G.O.A.T. unlocks automatically once the last remaining achievement is earned.

achievements.description: Find all Trinkets
achievements.summary: Collect all 200 @item{trinkets} hidden across @loc{San Angora}.

guide.context: Trinkets appear as map markers only after the region's @loc{Goat Tower} is synchronized, and the in-game collectibles screen tracks each region's count. Collecting the full set also awards the golden shoes, horns and fur.

steps.text: Synchronize all 6 @loc{Goat Tower}s so every region's trinket markers appear on the map.
Open the @mechanic{collectibles} screen and sweep each region, using the per-region counter to find stragglers.
Reach floating or hidden trinkets with flight gear such as the @item{jetpack} or the glider.
Collect all 200 trinkets until the counter reads 200 of 200.

achievements.description: Synchronize with all the Goat Towers
achievements.summary: Activate all 6 @loc{Goat Tower}s across @loc{San Angora}.

guide.context: Synchronizing a tower raises it and uncovers that region on the map, which also reveals its collectibles and instinct shrines.

steps.text: Travel to each @loc{Goat Tower} marked on your map and interact with its base to synchronize it.
steps.note: There are 6 towers in total, one per main region.

steps.text: Repeat until all 6 towers have been raised.

achievements.description: Complete all Instincts
achievements.summary: Complete all 99 @mechanic{instincts} in @loc{San Angora}.

guide.context: Instincts are optional objectives. New ones unlock from the 7 Instinct Shrines and from specific goats and gear, and the objectives screen tracks each one.

steps.text: Synchronize the local @loc{Goat Tower} and interact with all 7 @mechanic{Instinct Shrines} to reveal the shrine instincts.
steps.note: One shrine sits inside a Goat Tower's throne room.

steps.text: Unlock and equip the goats and gear that each carry their own instinct objectives, then perform them.
For instincts that require several NPCs at once, equip the @item{Goat Queen} accessory so summoned goats count toward the total.
Complete the remaining instincts until the objectives screen shows all 99 done.

achievements.description: Get flung out of the map
achievements.summary: Fly high enough with the @item{jetpack} to be flung out of the map.

steps.text: Pick up the @item{jetpack} at the marked location.
Jump into the pipe behind the jetpack and fly upward until the game teleports you back to the ground.

achievements.description: Change all 25 customizable items in the Goat Castle.
achievements.summary: Change every one of the 25 customizable items in the @loc{Goat Castle}.

guide.context: Castle customization opens at B tier, but all 25 slots only become available at S tier, so finish the castle ranks first.

steps.text: Raise the @loc{Goat Castle} to S tier.
Open the castle decoration menu and replace every customizable item.
steps.note: There are 25 items in total; swap each one at least once.

achievements.description: Jump off all Ramps
achievements.summary: Jump off all 29 @item{ramps} scattered across @loc{San Angora}.

guide.context: Only a full ramp launch counts. Each successful jump triggers slow motion and fireworks, and the in-game collectibles screen tracks how many ramps you have cleared per region.

steps.text: Open the @mechanic{collectibles} screen to see the ramp list and per-region progress counts.
Drive a vehicle to each marked ramp and launch off it at full speed.
steps.note: A successful ramp jump is confirmed by the slow-motion effect and fireworks.

steps.text: Clear all 29 ramps until the collectibles counter reads 29 of 29.

achievements.description: Finish the Multiverse of Nonsense story.
achievements.summary: Finish the entire @loc{Multiverse of Nonsense} story.

guide.context: The story is played across the three DLC regions, Koztroit, Durville and Mount Olympus, and ends after the last rift.

steps.text: Complete every rift and story quest in the Multiverse of Nonsense DLC.
Finish the closing story sequence to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Find all Broken Relics
achievements.summary: Collect all 30 @item{broken relics} across the three Multiverse regions.

guide.context: The relics are split between Koztroit, Durville and Mount Olympus and are tracked on the collectibles screen. A few only become reachable with gear earned from quests.

steps.text: Synchronize each DLC region's @loc{Goat Tower} and open the @mechanic{collectibles} screen to see the relic list.
Collect the open relics first, then return for the ones that need quest gear.
Use the mining paddle reward from the first rift to break the agate crystal at the dig site and drop into the relic pit.
steps.note: Some relics are buried by explosives; use the nearby TNT plunger in Durville where a stone covers one.

achievements.description: Take a full ride on Charon's boat.
achievements.summary: Take a full ride on @npc{Charon}'s boat in @loc{Mount Olympus}.

guide.context: Boarding the boat costs in-game money, and the achievement only counts after the ride finishes.

steps.text: In @loc{Mount Olympus}, enter the small cave that holds @npc{Charon}'s boat.
Board the boat and pay for the ride.
Wait for the ride to finish, then walk through the doors at the destination.

achievements.displayName: You Mined Too Greedily and Too Deep
achievements.description: Collect the Deep Stone.
achievements.summary: Collect the @item{Deep Stone} after completing the first rift.

steps.text: Complete the first @loc{rift} in the Multiverse of Nonsense DLC.
Pick up the @item{Deep Stone} that appears as the rift reward.

achievements.description: Watch the whole history documentary.
achievements.summary: Watch the whole history documentary during the substitute-teacher quest.

guide.context: The documentary runs for around 7 minutes and only plays during this quest.

steps.text: Start the substitute-teacher quest in the Multiverse of Nonsense DLC.
Pull out the television and sit with the goats.
Stay seated and watch the documentary to the end.

achievements.description: Complete all Instincts
achievements.summary: Complete every @mechanic{instinct} in the Multiverse of Nonsense DLC.

guide.context: The DLC instincts come from three wisdom wells and from goats and gear unlocked by completing DLC quests.

steps.text: Absorb the wisdom of all three @loc{wisdom wells} in the DLC map.
Complete the DLC quests that award the special gear carrying the remaining instincts.
Finish every remaining instinct objective.

achievements.description: Watch the complete Black Meze tour.
achievements.summary: Watch the entire @loc{Black Meze} tour presentation at the start of the Multiverse of Nonsense DLC.

steps.text: Start the Multiverse of Nonsense DLC and board the tour ride.
Sit through the full @loc{Black Meze} tour presentation without skipping.

achievements.description: Collect the Kidney Stone.
achievements.summary: Collect the @item{Kidney Stone} after completing the fourth rift.

steps.text: Complete the fourth @loc{rift} in the Multiverse of Nonsense DLC.
Pick up the @item{Kidney Stone} that appears as the rift reward.

achievements.description: Collect the Knowledge Stone.
achievements.summary: Collect the @item{Knowledge Stone} after completing the second rift.

steps.text: Complete the second @loc{rift} in the Multiverse of Nonsense DLC.
Pick up the @item{Knowledge Stone} that appears as the rift reward.

achievements.description: Lick Speedy while looking like Speedy
achievements.summary: Lick @npc{Speedy} in @loc{Durville} while transformed into @npc{Speedy}.

guide.context: This only becomes possible after the DLC story is finished. The transformation requires the capybara goat, the Speedy fur and the DLC speed sneakers.

steps.text: Finish the Multiverse of Nonsense story.
Become the capybara, buy the @item{Speedy} fur for it and equip the DLC speed sneakers.
In @loc{Durville}, wait on the cliff edge that @npc{Speedy} runs along and lick the character as it passes.
steps.note: It may take a few attempts to time the lick correctly.

achievements.description: Collect the Space Stone.
achievements.summary: Collect the @item{Space Stone} after completing the third rift.

steps.text: Complete the third @loc{rift} in the Multiverse of Nonsense DLC.
Pick up the @item{Space Stone} that appears as the rift reward.

achievements.description: Find all Multiverse Trinkets
achievements.summary: Collect all 60 Multiverse @item{trinkets} across @loc{Koztroit}, @loc{Durville} and @loc{Mount Olympus}.

guide.context: There are 20 trinkets in each of the three DLC regions, and the collectibles screen tracks each region's count. Some sit high above the map.

steps.text: Synchronize each DLC region's @loc{Goat Tower} so its trinket markers appear on the map.
Open the @mechanic{collectibles} screen and clear each region's 20 trinkets, using the counters to find the last few.
Reach floating trinkets with the DLC's flight gear, such as the propeller horns.
steps.note: Climb to the top of each region's tower or crystal to spot several trinkets at once.

achievements.description: Get flattened while driving the Trojan Goat
achievements.summary: Get flattened by a falling prop while driving the @item{Trojan Goat} in the @loc{Durville} bank yard.

steps.text: Find the @item{Trojan Goat} ride in @loc{Mount Olympus} and start driving it.
Drive the @item{Trojan Goat} to the bank in @loc{Durville}.
Park in the bank yard and wait until a piano or anvil falls on you.

achievements.description: Treat every patient as Dr. Pilgor.
achievements.summary: Treat every patient as @npc{Dr. Pilgor} in the DLC hospital.

steps.text: Find the DLC hospital, climb onto its roof and enter through the vent.
Take the @item{Dr. Pilgor} mask and equip it.
Sit on the hay and treat each patient in turn until the counter is complete.
steps.note: The full treatment run takes about 4 to 5 minutes.

achievements.description: Lick the flying train.
achievements.summary: Lick the flying train that appears after the @loc{Durville} art quest.

guide.context: The train appears only after finishing the Durville art quest, and it flies high above the map.

steps.text: Complete the @loc{Durville} art quest to make the flying train appear.
Reach a high vantage point such as the top of @loc{Mount Olympus} or the Floating Manor.
Use @item{Galaxy Horns} or another flight modifier to fly up to the train and lick it as it passes.

achievements.description: Complete every Hooferdome trial.
achievements.summary: Complete every @loc{Hooferdome} trial.

guide.context: The trials sit in the centre of the Hooferdome and are marked with a purple beam. This achievement is known to sometimes unlock before the final trial is cleared.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{Hooferdome} and find the trial area marked by a purple beam in the centre of town.
Read the task on the large board and complete it.
Press the red button to launch the next trial, and repeat until every trial is finished.

achievements.description: Drive a compressed car.
achievements.summary: Drive a compressed car after equipping the @item{Mechamaniac} costume.

guide.context: The costume comes from the Recycling Station task in Pilgor Town and is required to get into the compressed vehicle.

steps.text: In @loc{Pilgor Town}, unlock the Recycling Station and Garage with scrap.
In the Garage buy five motorcycle wheels and place all of them in the container marked with a tyre.
steps.note: Each wheel costs 5 scrap.

steps.text: Finish the Recycler task to earn the @item{Mechamaniac} costume.
Compress a car at the Junkyard or with the CUBOT 2000 costume, apply @item{Mechamaniac} to the cube and drive it.

achievements.description: Complete all Baadlands Instincts
achievements.summary: Complete all 47 @loc{Baadlands} @mechanic{instincts}.

guide.context: The Baadlands instincts come from two wisdom wells and from gear unlocked by the DLC's quests.

steps.text: Absorb the wisdom of the two @loc{wisdom wells} in the Baadlands.
Earn the special gear that carries the remaining instincts by completing Baadlands quests.
Complete all 47 instinct objectives.

achievements.description: Drive 42.195 km with your motorcycle
achievements.summary: Ride a @item{motorcycle} for a total of 42.195 km across the @loc{Baadlands}.

guide.context: Distance accumulates across the whole save, so the total can be worked up while clearing other Baadlands content.

steps.text: Ride the @item{motorcycle} whenever you travel instead of teleporting.
Combine the ride with collecting the golden wheels, which keeps you on the bike for long stretches.
steps.note: The counter is cumulative, so it can be finished over several sessions.

achievements.description: Open the Vault
achievements.summary: Unlock the vault after building all 8 @loc{Pilgor Town} structures.

guide.context: Every Pilgor Town structure costs scrap, and the vault opens only when all of them have been built.

steps.text: Build all eight @loc{Pilgor Town} structures with scrap: Camp Base, Fast Travel, Recycling Station, Living Quarters, Researcher's Lair, Garage, Town Hall and Agriculture.
Open the vault once every structure is in place.

achievements.description: Make a pineapple pizza
achievements.summary: Bake a pineapple pizza at the @loc{Newtown} pizzeria.

guide.context: The recipe needs a walking pineapple carried from Fruitopia in the motorcycle's luggage.

steps.text: Complete the @loc{Knead the Dough} quest in @loc{Newtown}.
Buy the @item{Luggage} tuning kit from the Garage and install it on your @item{motorcycle}.
In @loc{Fruitopia}, grab a walking pineapple and put it in the motorcycle's luggage.
Drive to the @loc{Newtown} pizzeria, take the pineapple out of the luggage and make the dough.
Use the pineapple as the topping in the pizza machine.

achievements.description: Jump off all Ramps
achievements.summary: Jump off all 20 @loc{Baadlands} @item{ramps} with a vehicle.

guide.context: Each ramp must be cleared while riding a vehicle such as the motorcycle.

steps.text: Open the Baadlands @mechanic{collectibles} screen to see the ramp list and progress count.
Ride a vehicle over every marked ramp until all 20 are recorded.

achievements.description: Find all Baadlands Trinkets
achievements.summary: Collect all 60 @loc{Baadlands} @item{trinkets}.

guide.context: The trinkets are spread across Pilgor Town, Rad Resort, Newtown, Hooferdome and Fruitopia, and the collectibles screen tracks each area's count.

steps.text: Buy the @item{propeller horns} in Rad Resort before starting, since some trinkets are out of reach without flight.
Open the @mechanic{collectibles} screen and clear each area's trinkets, using the counters to find the last few.
Fly to the trinkets that float high above the terrain and collect all 60.

achievements.description: Fully Upgrade Pilgor Town
achievements.summary: Fully upgrade @loc{Pilgor Town} by finishing the farm-worker and model-citizen quests.

guide.context: Both quests only appear after the matching Pilgor Town structures have been built.

steps.text: Build the Agriculture and Town Hall structures in @loc{Pilgor Town} with scrap.
Complete the Find Farm Workers and Model Citizen quests that become available afterwards.

achievements.description: Find all Golden Wheels
achievements.summary: Collect all 20 @loc{Baadlands} @item{golden wheels} while driving a vehicle.

guide.context: Golden wheels can only be picked up while you are seated in a vehicle.

steps.text: Stay on your @item{motorcycle} and drive to each golden wheel marker on the @mechanic{collectibles} screen.
Collect all 20 golden wheels.
steps.note: Collecting the wheels also builds distance toward the motorcycle marathon achievement.
